title: It's worth doing.
text:
The visit is worth it.The well-preserved and well-kept necropolis surprises.Good visit and detailed by the old town of Carmona.
And the best of all guide Henry of Vandalia. It gathers the best that can be asked of a good guide: professional, documented, adequate information without falling into vulgarities or pedantries.
author: AntonioMiguel_H

title: Visit to the Roman Necropolis
text: The whole village is monumental and typically Andalusian. On the one hand walls, churches and other monuments and on the other the narrow streets and white houses and also stately palaces.
author: W5156DYjaimeb

title: Not what we expected.
text: The day started nervously as we were staying in Seville, and when we booked the tour (months ago) the meeting point was listed as Necropolis main gate, Street name, Carmona, Seville. However we soon discovered that Carmona was about 35km from Seville. So, some frantic research, and we found that we can catch the bus to Carmona. On Arrival in Carmona, we found our Guide who informed us that the rules had changed and we could not visit the Necropolis, nor could we go into the Colosseum opposite.
